metadata.lab: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab
metadata.notes: Deploy into Sweden Central: East US and East US 2 currently block new Azure AI Search services. The lab VM uses the Spektra jump-VM image with a userData bootstrap (psscript-01.ps1), which finishes provisioning as the team user: it builds the MCP server image, creates the Power Platform developer environment, imports the Service Desk solution, seeds Dataverse and creates the Foundry agent. Nothing here creates Entra app registrations; the MCP gateway audience comes from the one-time tenant preparation (setup/tenant/Initialize-LabTenant.ps1).

Application (client) ID of the tenant-wide 'Relecloud Service Desk MCP Gateway' app registration created once by setup/tenant/Initialize-LabTenant.ps1. Its App ID URI api://<id> is the audience the agent identity requests a token for. Not a secret.
